message: I recently found myself in the middle of a blackout and it turned into a unique adventure. Without our usual screens, we dusted off some board games and shared stories by candlelight. It reminded me how much fun we can have with low-tech options! If you're curious about preparing for power outages and want some practical tips, I came across a great resource that can help. What’s your favorite low-tech activity to enjoy during a power outage?
